import os, tempfile
os.environ.setdefault("IPYTHONDIR", "/tmp/ipythontest_sp")
from pathlib import Path
from IPython.testing.globalipapp import start_ipython
from IPython.core import sessionbundle as sb
ip = start_ipython()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    path = str(Path(td) / "my session")
    r = ip.run_line_magic("session_bundle", f'start "{path}"')
    print("started:", r)
    ip.run_cell("1", store_history=True)
    r2 = ip.run_line_magic("session_bundle", "stop")
    _, events = sb.load_session_bundle(r2)
    print("events:", len(events))
PY
